Try this: Add dramatic side lighting.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with dark hair pulled back
at the crown rests one arm across her forehead,
with the other arm extended toward the lens. She
wears a fitted black long-sleeve knit with a high
neck. Her lips are warm coral, and her expression
is calm and direct. A deep charcoal backdrop with
soft gradient light falls off into shadow. Low-key
studio lighting, a palette of charcoal, black, and
warm coral. Dramatic and sleek, in the style of a
beauty campaign.
